name: Full-Funnel Server-Side Conversion Tracking & Event Deduplication
purpose: Deploy and maintain resilient, privacy-compliant server-side tracking across GA4, GTM, Google Enhanced Conversions, Meta CAPI, and TikTok Events API with event deduplication.
triggerConditions: Tracking audit detects > 15% event loss or deduplication mismatch
User prompt requesting conversion tracking setup or audit
prerequisites: GTM container ID and GA4 measurement ID available
Meta Pixel ID and long-lived CAPI access token active
TikTok Pixel ID and Events API access token active
Consent Management Platform (CMP) / Cookie Banner active on site

executionSteps.name: Audit Consent & Privacy Banner Status
executionSteps.action: Verify Google Consent Mode v2 (ad_storage, analytics_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization) implementation

executionSteps.name: Configure GTM Web & Server Containers
executionSteps.action: Deploy standardized dataLayer events (view_item, add_to_cart, initiate_checkout, purchase, generate_lead) with unique event_id

executionSteps.name: Setup Google Ads Enhanced Conversions
executionSteps.action: Configure first-party user data hashing (SHA-256 email, phone, address) for Google Ads conversion actions

executionSteps.name: Implement Meta CAPI Deduplication
executionSteps.action: Pair client-side fbq() calls with server-side CAPI events using identical event_id and event_name for 100% deduplication

executionSteps.name: Implement TikTok Events API Ingestion
executionSteps.action: Connect TikTok Events API with browser Pixel events matching event_id and client IP/User Agent

executionSteps.name: Simulate Live Test Conversions
executionSteps.action: Execute test purchase through GTM preview mode and Meta Events Manager Test Events tool to verify match quality

expectedOutputs: Tracking Health & Event Match Quality Scorecard
GTM Tag and Trigger Verification Sheet
successCriteria: Meta Event Match Quality Score >= 8.0 out of 10
Google Enhanced Conversions status: 'Active (Recording Enhanced Conversions)'
TikTok Events API active with deduplication rate > 95%
GA4 real-time debug view recording accurate purchase values

failureHandling.retryStrategy: Retry test event dispatch 3 times with 5s delay

rollbackStrategy: Revert GTM container to prior published version if tags cause page latency or duplicate transaction recordings.
